scope: Shared contract deltas introduced or hardened by U02-U07; legacy compatibility paths; retained fixtures; pre-migration data/caller scan.

contracts.change: Audit expectation derives split layout only from blueprint responsive_policy.expanded == STAGE_SUPPORT; retained fractions cannot force a split for SINGLE_PANE.

compatibility.legacy_path: STAGE_SUPPORT keeps support_fraction/minPx split expectation; SINGLE_PANE ignores historical fractions for split expectation.

contracts.notes: No blueprint registry/schema, renderer layout generation, learner-quality rule, or subject record changed.

contracts.change: No production contract change; existing AUTHOR_ONLY / RENDERED / INDEPENDENT_RENDERED basis and artifact SHA binding were only moved into focused regression coverage.

compatibility.legacy_path: Legacy rendered reviews continue existing semantics; opt-in independent_rendered_review_required adds stricter acceptance only when explicitly enabled.

contracts.area: difficulty evidence and QRT demand/crux binding
changes: learner-question-metadata vocabulary 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 adds subject-neutral 0/1/2 difficulty-component rubric.
package schema adds optional difficulty.component_evidence requiring all five component evidence strings when present.
cognitive-demand vocabulary 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 states primary demand classifies answer.crux_move_ref.
QRT resolver requires crux_move_ref to resolve inside answer.reasoning_route[] and derives primary_move_ref/kind/action plus a primary_move basis digest.

legacy_path: Difficulty component_evidence is optional; legacy difficulty records remain schema-valid.
Packages without a normalized grade9v3:cognitive_demand claim are unaffected until QRT classification is requested.
A cognitive-demand claim entering QRT must now have a resolvable canonical crux; floating legacy claims fail closed instead of being silently accepted.
compatibility.migration_required: only for records/callers that need new-contract QRT adjudication and lack crux/evidence; no bulk package migration justified.

data_scan.conclusion: 81 legacy difficulty records remain valid by design; there is no canonical normalized-demand record requiring crux migration in the scanned live subject libraries.

changes: Optional availability on core2_support_plan.support_completions[] and visual stages[].
Projection exposes pre_solution_support / after_attempt_support / post_solution_support and pre/after/post visual stage refs.
Renderer adds commitment-gated 'More support after your attempt' separately from full 'Answer and working'.

legacy_path: eligible_pre_solution remains as a compatibility projection of PRE_ATTEMPT_SAFE.
compatibility.adoption_rule: Add availability only when an author needs behavior different from the legacy default, especially AFTER_ATTEMPT.

data_scan.conclusion: No live canonical subject-library support plan requires migration; staged fixtures intentionally prove omitted-field legacy behavior.

contracts.change: scene_instance owner choice changes anyOf -> oneOf for existing microtopic_ref vs question_ref.

legacy_path: both-owner and ownerless instances are now invalid.
compatibility.migration_required: only if a stored scene instance carries both or neither owner ref.

additional_retained_scene_instances_chec: staged Set B adopted cases: question-only valid
data_scan.conclusion: No stored retained/canonical scene instance found requiring owner-cardinality migration.

changes: New diagnostic evidence record: misconception_index + canonical probe + observed_response + diagnosis + evaluator basis.
Bare misconception_index no longer selects MISCONCEPTION_REPAIR.
Only complete CONFIRMED evidence may enter misconception-specific repair; REFUTED/INDETERMINATE remain DIAGNOSE.
study_session API/CLI retains misconception_index but adds diagnostic_response / diagnosis / diagnostic_basis.

compatibility.kind: syntactic compatibility with deliberate semantic tightening
compatibility.legacy_path: misconception_index is still accepted as a hypothesis selector, but old callers that expected immediate repair must now supply discriminating evidence.

migration_candidates: tests/test_feedback.py — multiple bare-index calls still assert REPAIR.
tests/test_study_session.py — confirmed-misconception test passes only misconception_index but asserts REPAIR.
docs/HIGH-LIKELIHOOD-LEARNING-SCENARIOS.md — runtime field list omits diagnostic evidence fields.
docs/CORE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN-WORKSHEET-STUDY-FEEDBACK.md — runtime example predates typed diagnostic evidence.
contracts.migration_rule: Migrate only callers that semantically mean CONFIRMED. Preserve at least one explicit bare-index regression proving it remains DIAGNOSE.

branch_state_observation.informational_suite: 190 tests; 7 failures, 1 error, 1 skip; known broader repository failures remain and are not treated as U09 migration proof.

u09b_plan: Migrate legacy diagnostic callers/tests/docs that assert bare-index confirmation to explicit diagnostic evidence.
Keep negative regression that bare misconception_index alone returns DIAGNOSE.
Do not bulk-add difficulty component_evidence to 81 legacy records.
Do not bulk-add support availability where legacy defaults already preserve behavior.
Do not rewrite scene ownership records; scans found no invalid retained/canonical instance.
Do not modify U03 review schema/guard or U02 blueprint records.
